meta.description: Bangladesh's verified second-hand marketplace. Every seller is NID-verified, every interaction is accountable.

home.title: Buy and sell with peace of mind
home.subtitle: Every seller is NID-verified. Second-hand phones, cars, furniture and more across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.
home.searchHint: What are you looking for? e.g. iPhone 13, motorcycle, sofa
home.categoriesSubtitle: Pick the category that fits what you need
home.trust1Body: Every seller completes NID verification through the Porichoy gateway before posting a listing.
home.trust2Body: Identity is keyed to the NID hash — changing a phone number cannot erase a banned identity.
home.trust3Body: Buyers complete NID verification before starting a chat. Phone numbers are shown only to verified buyers.
home.trust4Body: Every report is reviewed and every enforcement decision is written to a tamper-evident audit log.
home.noResultsBody: We could not load recent listings. Try again shortly or browse another category.

category.subtitle: All verified listings in this category
category.emptyTitle: No listings in this category yet
category.emptyBody: New listings will appear here as soon as sellers post them.

search.heading: Search
search.subheading: Filter by keyword, category, district and price
search.emptyBody: Try different filters or a shorter keyword.
search.degraded: Search is running in limited mode — some results may be missing.

listing.mapDistrictOnly: The seller shared only the district ({district}) — confirm the exact meeting point in chat.
listing.contactBody: Log in and complete buyer NID verification to start a chat. The seller's phone number is shown only to verified buyers.
listing.contactNote: Never send money in advance. Meet in a safe, public place.
listing.safety1: Inspect the item in person before paying.
listing.safety2: Avoid advance payments or transfers to personal accounts.
listing.safety3: Report the listing if something looks suspicious.
listing.unavailableBody: It may have been removed or is no longer active.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Start with your mobile number — no password needed.
login.phoneError: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.
login.notice: OTP sign-in opens with the account release. You can browse every public listing today.
login.consentPrefix: By continuing you agree to the
login.why1: Start chatting after buyer NID verification.
login.why2: Save favourites and keep your searches.
login.why3: Post listings, buy boosts and manage deals as a seller.
